args: For lcms/src/cmstypes.c Type_MPEclut_Read and lcms/src/cmslut.c CLUT allocation functions, what exact channel bounds are expected by surrounding pipeline APIs, and should cmsStageAllocCLut16bitGranular/cmsStageAllocCLutFloatGranular reject zero or >= MAX_STAGE_CHANNELS channels? Also identify all integer-overflow concerns in CubeSize and outputChan * CubeSize.

The supplied ASan report shows a malicious MPE CLUT with InputChans=3 and OutputChans=0x4001 reaching TetrahedralInterpFloat, overflowing fixed pipeline buffers. Type_MPEclut_Read currently checks only nonzero channel counts. The granular CLUT allocators check inputChan > MAX_INPUT_DIMENSIONS but do unchecked outputChan * CubeSize. CubeSize itself multiplies rv by dim before testing rv > UINT_MAX/dim, so its overflow check is ineffective. I plan parser channel validation plus root-level allocator arithmetic hardening, while preserving valid public API behavior.
